name: Lemon-Herb Salmon, Zucchini & Halloumi Skewers with Tomato Salad & Roast Potatoes (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

If using wooden skewers, place 6-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them. (Alternatively, you can cook the salmon, halloumi, and zucchini pieces directly on the pan without using skewers.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb new potatoes
1 lemon
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
2 medium zucchini squash
1 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes, then transfer to a baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, then stir to coat. Spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until potatoes are golden and fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice half of the lemon into a medium bowl. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)

Pick basil leaves off the stems; shave parsley leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the bowl with the lemon, along with oil, honey, and spices, then whisk to combine the herb sauce. Transfer half to a small bowl and set aside for later use.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp honey
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp smoked paprika

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into 1-inch thick half-moons. Place 1 cup of zucchini on a plate, then add remaining zucchini to the bowl with the herb sauce.

If using salmon with skin, place the fillet, skin-side down, on a cutting board. Holding the tail end (or corner) firmly, use a knife to cut between the flesh and skin; continue to cut through the length of the fillet (take care not to cut through the skin); discard the skin. Cut the salmon into 1-inch cubes. Add 1 cup of salmon to the plate with the zucchini, then add remaining salmon to the bowl and toss to combine.
Pat halloumi dry with paper towels. Using a clean cutting board, large dice and season with pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (9 oz) pkg halloumi cheese
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thread plain zucchini and salmon onto 2 skewers, alternating ingredients. Return to the plate, then season with salt and pepper. Thread the halloumi and lemon-herb marinated zucchini and salmon onto remaining skewers, alternating ingredients. Add to the plate with the kid's skewers, keeping them separate.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers and grill, turning every 1 ½-2 minutes, until salmon is opaque and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Set aside a ½-cup tomatoes for the kids plates. Add remaining tomatoes to the bowl and stir to combine the tomato salad.
Juice reserved lemon into the bowl with the reserved herb sauce. Add more oil and stir to combine.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Remove plain salmon and zucchini from the skewers. Divide between plates, along with 1 cup of potatoes and reserved tomatoes.

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining skewers, potatoes, and tomato salad between plates. Drizzle skewers with lemon-herb sauce and enjoy!
